test_objective: Check that the default @context is used if the Content-Type header is "application/json" and the Link header does not contain a JSON-LD @context

test_cases.name: 033_05_01 Create one context source registration using the default context with JSON content type with Context
test_cases.doc: Check that the default @context is used if the Content-Type header is "application/json" and the Link header does not contain a JSON-LD @context and retrieve the information with ngsild context
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/csourceRegistrations'
        method set to 'POST'
        Request Header['Content-Type'] set to 'application/ld+json' and
 payload defined in file: '${updated_payload}'
}
